'Is the wold-warden of' is not a subprop.why: "Wold-warden" is a made-up relation (catalogued as wold_warden_of, fictional, no property tags): nobody uses the phrase and it has no default reading about whether the warden lies in the place it watches. The instances are made-up cities and countries (Orvane in Kestmoor, Tarnvale in Drelmoor), so no real location the model holds can answer for or against 'lies in'; the answer rests on the edited property alone.

The Mississippi River flows into the Gul.why: Stated in the lead of the Mississippi River article.

notes: RBox expansion paired with geography-replace-0012 (which makes 'is the capital of' not a subproperty of 'is located in'): a made-up relation, wold_warden_of (city to country), is given the same property. The instances use invented cities and countries (Orvane and Kestmoor, Tarnvale and Drelmoor): the first version used Bogota/Colombia and Nairobi/Kenya, whose real locations answered the question independently of the edit. The direct question, the cross-lingual queries and the first instance ask whether location follows (no), the second whether it could fail (yes). Caveat: for an unknown relation these answers are also close to the defaults, so an unedited model may already pass.
